sources.novel_basis: chapter 8: Lin Chong receives twenty strokes and a seven-and-a-half-jin round-headed iron-leaf cangue; Dong Chao and Xue Ba escort him during the sixth-month heat
chapter 8: Dong Chao is one of the two escort constables; the pair carry their baggage and wooden water-fire staffs in the sixth-month heat
chapter 8: Xue Ba is the other escort constable; he scalds Lin Chong's feet, gives him new straw sandals and drives him onward with a wooden water-fire staff

chapter 66: at the Lantern Festival Shi Qian carries a basket of sulfur and saltpeter fire-starting materials with several nao-e ornaments and pretends to sell them; he does not carry a constant torch
chapter 50: Shi Xiu deliberately lets Sun Li capture him and puts himself into the prison cart; the text does not specify a cangue, so this state uses restrained wrists without inventing one
